title: 3danisosmooth
description: Smooths a dataset using an anisotropic smoothing technique.

2d_flag.description: Smooth a slice at a time (default)
2d_flag.title: 2D smoothing flag

mask_dataset.description: Use specified dataset as mask to include/exclude voxels
mask_dataset.title: Mask dataset

viewer_flag.description: Show central axial slice image every iteration
viewer_flag.title: Viewer flag

nosmooth_flag.description: Do not do intermediate smoothing of gradients
nosmooth_flag.title: No intermediate smoothing flag

sigma1.description: Gaussian smoothing sigma before gradient computation (default=0.5)
sigma1.title: Sigma1

sigma2.description: Gaussian smoothing sigma after gradient computation (default=1.0)
sigma2.title: Sigma2

save_temp_with_diff_measures_flag.description: Save temporary datasets with different measures in a dataset
save_temp_with_diff_measures_flag.title: Save temporary datasets with different measures flag

phiding_flag.description: Use Ding method for computing phi (default)
phiding_flag.title: Use Ding method for phi

phiexp_flag.description: Use exponential method for computing phi
phiexp_flag.title: Use exponential method for phi

setneg_value.description: Set negative voxels to specified value
setneg_value.title: Set negative voxels value

edgefraction.description: Adjust the fraction of the anisotropic component added (0 to 1, default=0.5)
edgefraction.title: Edge fraction

datum_type.description: Specify type for output data (byte, short, float) [default=float]
datum_type.title: Datum type

matchorig_flag.description: Match datum type and clip min/max to input data
matchorig_flag.title: Match original datatype
